#: Strings of MO2 ApI Bridge, section "plugin". Keys are short Latin labels and never change - translate the right-hand sides only. Placeholders like %(mod)s are filled in by the plugin: keep them spelled exactly, or the line is shown raw. A key starting with # is a note for translators and is ignored. To add a language, copy the folder next to this one and translate the files inside; the plugin reads whatever folders it finds, and a section may be added as a new file without touching the others.
plugin.description: Local HTTP bridge to a running MO2: mod list, virtual Data reads, plugin load order, launching tools inside the VFS.
plugin.tooltip: Show the local bridge address and token
setting.enabled: start the bridge together with MO2
